C0333.title: Xinmi Court Convicts Man for Transferring Company Account Materials Used in Cybercrime
C0333.summary: In November 2024, the Zhengzhou court system reported that Xinmi Court had concluded an aiding information network criminal activities case. Zhu, knowing that company materials might be used for illegal activity, handed over a business license, seals, corporate bank account, U-shield, account password, and other materials to another person and received 5,000 yuan. The account generated more than 56 million yuan in flows within a week, including over 13 million yuan in telecom-fraud victim funds. The court sentenced Zhu to six months in prison and fined him 5,000 yuan.
